description: Remove a concept from the vault and all of its outgoing edges. Use to clear a note that is wrong, obsolete, or junk (e.g. a probe or test node that shouldn't be in the graph). Idempotent: deleting an id that doesn't exist is a no-op success (deleted:false), not an error. Deletion is permanent — prefer upsert_concept to correct a note you want to keep. Returns { deleted, id }.

id.description: Exact concept id (slug) to delete, e.g. "lead-scoring".

name: delete_concept
title: Delete concept
